relationships.subject: Botulinum toxin A
relationships.evidence_quote: It reduces the delivery of this receptor to cell membranes and can diminish peripheral sensitization, neurogenic inflammation, and pain

relationships.subject: Botulinum toxin A
relationships.evidence_quote: inhibition of pain mediators such as substance P, bradykinin, and glutamate by degradation of SNAP-25

key_findings: Review: BT-A is approved for chronic migraine since 2010 and shows benefit in TN, TTH, cluster headache and other non-migraine head pain in limited trials
Proposed mechanisms include inhibiting CGRP/substance P/glutamate release and reducing TRPV1 membrane delivery
